ValidationRule.description: INT-024 — An Adjustment Reason is required when the Approved Amount differs from the Proposed Amount.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Approved_Amount__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Proposed_Amount__c)), Approved_Amount__c <> Proposed_Amount__c, ISBLANK(Adjustment_Reason__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An Adjustment Reason is required when the Approved Amount differs from the Proposed Amount.
